news.title: Estrogen Patch Supply Still Falls Short of Demand While the Product Stays Off the Federal Shortage List
news.description: Manufacturers say the supply of estrogen patches cannot meet demand, but the FDA has not listed estradiol patches as in shortage. Here is why that gap matters.
